metadata.description: Yili Yang's Claude Code skills in one plugin: a thinking framework, interviewing before answering, up-to-date domain briefings, digesting material in any form, purchase research, a wardrobe record with technical clothing facts, writing in his own voice, and plain technical English.

plugins.name: yili-skills
plugins.description: Eight skills that each answer one question and find each other by need: i-think-like-this (how to reason and judge what is true), interview-me-before-answer (who is asking and how they decide), updated-domain-expert (sourced, dated briefings on what an expert knows now), digest-distill-information (what videos, posts, threads and reports actually say and show), research-before-buy (purchase decisions), wardrobe (the wardrobe record, and the technical facts about a piece: fibre, make, brand, fit), write-like-myself (writing in Yili Yang's voice) and talk-standard-tech-eng (plain, stable technical English).
